claims: As of April 2026, Microsoft has released updates (e.g., KB5082063) fixing over 160 security flaws, including active zero-day vulnerabilities.
The April 2026 update addresses 165 flaws, including one exploited zero-day.
Extended Security Updates (ESU) are available for Windows 10.
Some systems with specific, non-standard Group Policy configurations might be prompted for a BitLocker recovery key after the April 2026 update
